definitions.gloss: to commute, to go back and forth
definitions.explanation: To travel regularly between two places, especially for work or school.
To go to a place regularly for lessons, treatment, or other purposes.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive). Pattern: X⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{通|かよ}う (commute to X, attend X regularly). X⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧ also occurs and is slightly more formal.

ASPECT: て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ is the normal form for describing a current routine. {通|かよ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ means 'I commute / I attend' as an ongoing habit, not 'I am on my way'. To say you are on your way somewhere right now, use ⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ instead.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{通|かよ}う: commute to work
- ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{通|かよ}う: go to school
- ⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{通|かよ}う: go to the hospital for ongoing treatment
- ⟦{塾|じゅく}→塾：04702_juku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{通|かよ}う: attend cram school
- {通|かよ}い: the noun form, as in {通|かよ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧ (the route one takes regularly)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: plain 'go', a single trip or a general statement. {通|かよ}う adds that the trip repeats, in both directions, over a stretch of time. ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ can be about today; ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{通|かよ}う says you are enrolled there.
- ⟦{通勤|つうきん}する→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧: commuting to work specifically, and more formal — the word used on forms and in HR documents
- ⟦{通学|つうがく}する→通学：03510_tsuugaku⟧: commuting to school specifically, likewise more formal

REGISTER: Neutral and very common in ordinary conversation. Where ⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧ and ⟦{通学|つうがく}→通学：03510_tsuugaku⟧ are nouns tied to one destination type, {通|かよ}う is the general-purpose verb and works for gyms, clinics, lessons, and workplaces alike.
